agents.label: AI Agents
agents.title: AI agents already in production
agents.desc: We build agents that do one job properly inside a business: answer customers, watch a process, read documents. We run them on our own products first, with real traffic, before we offer them to anyone else.

a1.title: They answer customers at any hour
a1.desc: An agent replies on WhatsApp or on your site through the night, in the customer's own language, and hands the conversation to a person only when it really needs one.

a2.title: They keep an eye on the process
a2.desc: They check by themselves that every order, booking or delivery is covered. If something slips through, they tell the right person on Telegram, not the next morning.

a3.title: They read the paperwork for you
a3.desc: Invoices, contracts, quotes: the agent opens them, pulls out the figures that matter and writes them where they belong. No more retyping by hand.

a4.title: They work inside the software you already have
a4.desc: They plug into your back office, your CRM or the platform your team uses every day, and take over the repetitive part nobody wants to do.

agents.proof: Ibiza Amigo is our own agent on WhatsApp: every day it talks to real tourists in Ibiza, recommends venues and boats and passes bookings to our partners. Not a demo.

cookies.message: We use technical cookies to ensure the site works properly and analytics cookies to improve your experience.

what.title: What Are Cookies
what.content: Cookies are small text files that websites store on your device while browsing. They help the site function and improve user experience.

types.title: Types of Cookies Used
types.content: Technical cookies: necessary for the site to function (session, language preferences). No consent required. Analytics cookies: Google Analytics, used to analyze traffic anonymously. Activated only with your consent.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Cookies
thirdParty.content: The site may use third-party services (Google Analytics) that install their own cookies. These services have their own privacy policies.

manage.title: Managing Cookies
manage.content: You can manage cookie preferences at any time from your browser settings. Disabling some cookies may affect site functionality.

woodDesign.label: Real case · Workshop management
woodDesign.title: Wood Design Ibiza
woodDesign.lead: The system that runs a carpentry workshop in Ibiza. Every job in one place — quote, proforma, invoice, hours, payments and photos — from the phone.
woodDesign.demoNote: This is the real demo with sample data. Tap it — it works.
woodDesign.featuresTitle: A whole workshop in your pocket

obra.title: Every job is an «obra»
obra.desc: A door or a kitchen becomes a new obra. Inside: quote, proformas, invoices, photos, measurements, expenses and stage.

docs.title: Quotes and invoices in seconds
docs.desc: Own numbering series, invoices locked once issued, rectifying invoices, discounts tracked. PDF and WhatsApp sharing.

pay.title: Payments by milestone
pay.desc: A 60/30/10 payment plan, deposits and free payments, a proforma for every milestone.

hours.title: Hours become an invoice
hours.desc: Hours logged on each job turn into an invoice «por administración» at the hourly rate.

ai.title: AI reads the receipts
ai.desc: Photo of a receipt → supplier, tax ID, date, base and VAT filled in by themselves. Workshop stock and material used per job.

close.title: Month close for the accountant
close.desc: One button: issued invoices, receipt photos and spreadsheets in a single ZIP, ready for the gestoría.

woodDesign.signDesc: Every quote and invoice from the workshop carries «Software: Digital Energy». If you got here from one of them — this is what built it.
woodDesign.ctaDesc: We build the same kind of system around the way you already work: jobs, people, documents, payments.
